dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Browns Face Raiders With Playoff Hopes Tied to Watson's Late-Game Heroics
dailyTopNewsBrief.summary: Under head coach Todd Monken, Cleveland (6-4) holds the AFC's sixth seed despite losing safety Ronnie Hickman to a concussion, relying on a top-five pass defense and Deshaun Watson's late-game execution.
bullets: Quarterback Deshaun Watson has been central to Cleveland's 2026 success, recording six fourth-quarter game-winning drives to keep the team in postseason contention [Cleveland Browns Official](https://www.clevelandbrowns.com/news/deshaun-watson-plays-key-part-in-browns-success-in-2026).

The front office signed tight end Carsen Ryan to the practice squad this week following his nine active appearances earlier this season [Cleveland Browns Official](https://www.clevelandbrowns.com/news/browns-sign-te-carsen-ryan-to-the-practice-squad-x0701).

Offensive coordinator Travis Switzer must navigate a league-worst 11.5% sack rate allowed against a Raiders team that ranks 6th in pass protection and 5th in defensive takeaways [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50520404/nfl-offensive-coordinators-playcallers-midseason-report).

Infrastructure development continues with the Huntington Bank Field project in Brook Park, a reimagined entertainment venue projected to open in the fall of 2029 [Cleveland Browns Official](https://www.clevelandbrowns.com/news/new-huntington-bank-field-to-provide-reimagined-entertainment-value).
